$description: Statistical comparison report for a FuzzBench fuzzing experiment. All floating-point values should be rounded to 6 decimal places where applicable.

median_final_coverage.description: Median edges covered at the final time point across all trials, per benchmark, per fuzzer.

overall_test_statistic.description: Omnibus test statistic for differences in fuzzer performance across benchmarks.

average_ranks.description: Each fuzzer's average rank across benchmarks. Rank 1 = best (highest coverage).

pairwise_p_values.description: Post-hoc pairwise comparison p-values with appropriate multiple-comparison correction. Keys use format '<a>_vs_<b>' where a < b lexicographically.

critical_difference.description: Minimum average rank difference required for statistical significance at alpha=0.05.

average_normalized_scores.description: Per benchmark, trial coverages are min-max normalized to [0,1] using the global min and max across ALL fuzzers' trials in that benchmark. The median normalized value per fuzzer per benchmark is then averaged across benchmarks.

pairwise_effect_sizes.description: Per benchmark, per ordered fuzzer pair: the probability that a randomly chosen observation from fuzzer A exceeds one from fuzzer B, plus half the probability of a tie. Keys use '<a>_vs_<b>' where a < b lexicographically.

ranking.description: Fuzzers ordered from best (lowest average rank) to worst (highest average rank).

equivalent_groups.description: Groups of fuzzers whose pairwise differences are not statistically significant (p > 0.05). Each group is a connected component in the graph where fuzzers are linked iff their pairwise p-value exceeds 0.05. Inner arrays sorted alphabetically; outer array sorted by first element.
